Companion Animal Travel Desk: Pet Travel Guidance

This guide covers the main checks for animal travel with Aurelia Skyways. Keep the pet comfortable, keep documents ready, and follow the carrier rules before arrival. Staff will review the case with care and direct you to the correct service point.

For cats, <<FACT F061>> Bring a secure crate, clean bedding, and a calm plan for handling at the airport. If the crate is damaged or poorly fitted, the animal may not be accepted.

For small dogs, <<FACT F074>> Carry the required papers and make sure the animal is fit to travel. A welfare coordinator will note signs of stress and may ask for a brief check if comfort is in doubt.

Arrival early is strongly advised so you have room for screening and final checks. Keep food, water, and medication accessible, and do not open the crate unless staff instruct you to do so.

For further help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.
